title: Zauner’s Weyl–Heisenberg SIC existence conjecture
statement: In every finite dimension d≥2 there exists a Weyl–Heisenberg-covariant symmetric informationally complete POVM.

counterexample.description: Refute universality by choosing a dimension and certifying that its finite fiducial polynomial system has no complex solution, using Nullstellensatz, CAD, or interval certificates.
